full_judgment: Mr. Muhammad Abdul Mannan. J:-This Civil Revision arises out of the judgment and decree passed by the Subordinate Judge, Chandpur on 28.2.1985 in Title Appeal No. 14 of 1983 reversing those of the learned Munsif, 1st Court, Chandpur dated 29.12.82 in Title Suit No. 183 of 1977 sending back the suit on remand for hearing of the arguments of both sides and deliver a judgment on merit of the suit rejecting the solenama filed by the parties. The aforesaid judgment and decree was passed in terms of the compromise petition filed by defendant No. 1 and 2 the plaintiff No. 1. The defendant No. 2 as petitioner preferred this application before this Court.
